entries.Omegasis.HappyBirthday.BirthdayGreeting: Happy birthday, @! Hopefully this year we can go on even more adventures together! $h
Hey, {{Omegasis.HappyBirthday/AffectionateSpouseWord}}. You know every day feels like a great adventure with you! Happy birthday! $l
Yo, @, happy birthday! Here's to making this the best year yet! $h
Hey, {{Omegasis.HappyBirthday/AffectionateSpouseWord}}. I'm so glad that I married you. You make every day feel like winning a sports match. Happy birthday! $l

Good {{Omegasis.HappyBirthday/TimeOfDay}}, {{Omegasis.HappyBirthday/AffectionateSpouseWord}}. I was just thinking on how you have been a muse for my work. You inspire me every day I spend with you. Happy birthday! $l
Happy birthday, @! I can see your future shining bright like a star! $h

Happy birthday, @. Hopefully this year you'll get some good presents! $h

You know, {{Omegasis.HappyBirthday/AffectionateSpouseWord}}, we've come a long way since we first met, but I'm glad we took this journey together. Every day feels picture perfect with you. Happy birthday! $l
Happy birthday, @. Come in for a checkup sometime, alright? I want to make sure you'll see plenty more.

Good {{Omegasis.HappyBirthday/TimeOfDay}}, {{Omegasis.HappyBirthday/AffectionateSpouseWord}}. I was just thinking on how invigorated I've felt since marrying you. When I look at you, I feel as I'm positively glowing with joy. Happy birthday! $l
Happy birthday, @. I still don't quite understand humans, but I'm glad to have met you all the same.

Good {{Omegasis.HappyBirthday/TimeOfDay}}. I'm glad that we have the opportunity to live together as it has taught me much about both you and your human culture, including how birthdays are celebrated. Here's hoping we can spend many more years together. Happy birthday @! $h
Hey, @, happy birthday! I'm glad to see you're doing well on the farm. $h

Hey, {{Omegasis.HappyBirthday/TimeOfDay}}, {{Omegasis.HappyBirthday/AffectionateSpouseWord}}. Being with you has been a great inspiration to me. I might sculpt wood, but being with you has helped sculpt my life. Happy birthday! $l
Happy birthday, @. I tried to make an everlasting candle for you, but sadly that didn't work out. Maybe next year, right? $h
Happy birthday, {{Omegasis.HappyBirthday/AffectionateSpouseWord}}. I always thought I had to look into space to find a shooting star but when I look at you I realize I already have one. $l
Happy birthday, @. May you enjoy all of life's blessings this year. $h

Happy birthday, {{Omegasis.HappyBirthday/AffectionateSpouseWord}}. I always read about happy endings in books but being with you makes me realize that it continues well into the future. Here is to many more years to come. $l
Hey, @, happy birthday! We'll have to have a birthday jam session for you sometime! $h

Good {{Omegasis.HappyBirthday/TimeOfDay}}, {{Omegasis.HappyBirthday/AffectionateSpouseWord}}. You know, I never saw myself settling down before I met you, but now that I have, I feel like I never want to look back. Happy birthday! $l
Happy birthday, @. Hope things are going well down at the farm.
I was never a big celebrator of birthdays, but with you, today is special. Happy birthday, {{Omegasis.HappyBirthday/AffectionateSpouseWord}}. $l
Happy birthday, @. Keep working hard, and I'm sure this next year will be a great one for you.
I never though I'd enjoy anything but drinking on birthdays, but you've shown me how to live a great life. Happy birthday, {{Omegasis.HappyBirthday/AffectionateSpouseWord}}. $l
Happy birthday, @. Thank you for all that you've done for our community. I'm sure your parents must be proud of you. $h

You know, you sure are a diamond in the rough for me. I thought I would have nothing but hot sweaty years with just me and the forge, but I'm glad you saw my heart just like a gem in a geode. Happy birthday, {{Omegasis.HappyBirthday/AffectionateSpouseWord}}. $l
Aww, sweetie, you came all the way out here to see me on your birthday?$h#$b#Well, then, the least I can do is wish you a happy one!~ $h

I'm so glad that our paths crossed and so appreciative of all the times you came to visit me in the desert. Now I'm overjoyed that I get to spend every day and the rest of my life with you! Happy birthday, {{Omegasis.HappyBirthday/AffectionateSpouseWord}}. $l
Happy birthday, @. Thank you for all that you've done for our community. I'm sure your parents must be proud of you. $h
Happy birthday, @! Make sure you take some time off today to enjoy yourself. $h

When you get to my age, birthdays start to come and go. Still, happy birthday, @.

Happy birthday, @. I'm glad I decided to get to know you.

entries.Omegasis.HappyBirthday_Dad: Dear @,^  Happy birthday kiddo. It's been a little quiet around here on your birthday since you aren't around, but your mother and I know that you are making both your grandpa and us proud.  We both know that living on your own can be tough but we believe in you one hundred percent, just keep following your dreams.^  Love, Dad ^ P.S. Here's some spending money to help you out on the farm. Good luck! {{Omegasis.HappyBirthday/DadsBirthdayGift}}[#]Happy Birthday from Dad
entries.Omegasis.HappyBirthday_Dad_Married: Dear @,^  Happy birthday kiddo. It seems like just the other day we were staying up late watching movies, going on bike rides together after school, making all kinds of food together on the weekend, and visiting your grandpa out on the farm. Now here you are all grown up, making those happy memories together with the love of your life. I know your mom and I couldn't be prouder of you, and I'm sure grandpa would say the same knowing you have inherited his legacy. Keep working hard on living the best life and I'll keep wishing you the best for all these special years to come.^Love, Dad ^ P.S. Here's some spending money to help you out on the farm. Good luck! {{Omegasis.HappyBirthday/DadsBirthdayGift}}[#]Happy Birthday from Dad
